Global (All).title: US-China Relations Suffer Significant Setback Amid Rising Tensions over Taiwan
Global (All).summary: The Biden administration has announced a long-awaited meeting between US and Chinese officials, sparking fears of rising tensions between the two nations. The tensions are further exacerbated by China's increasing assertiveness in the South China Sea.

Global (All).title: Global Food Prices Hit Record High Amid Ongoing Conflict in Ukraine
Global (All).summary: The ongoing conflict in Ukraine has led to a significant increase in global food prices, causing widespread economic instability and food shortages in many countries.

Global (All).title: European Union Mulls Introducing New Sanctions on Russia Amid Continued Aggression in Ukraine
Global (All).summary: The European Union is considering introducing new sanctions on Russia in response to its continued aggression in Ukraine. The sanctions would aim to isolate Russia economically and put pressure on the government to cease its military actions.

United States.title: Rising Tensions between the US and China over Taiwan
United States.summary: The US has announced plans to provide Taiwan with additional military aid, prompting a strong response from China, which sees Taiwan as a part of its territory.

United States.title: Mass Shootings in Multiple US Cities
United States.summary: There have been reports of multiple mass shootings in US cities, including a shooting in a school in Wisconsin and a shooting at a nightclub in Illinois, raising concerns about gun violence in the country.

United States.title: US Supreme Court Abortion Decision Sparks Protests and Violence
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court has overturned the landmark Roe v. Wade decision, sparking widespread protests and violence across the country as abortion rights activists clash with pro-life groups.

South Korea.title: North Korea warns South Korea and US against large military exercise
South Korea.summary: Pyongyang criticises planned drills, claiming they pose ‘a grave threat’ to the region.

South Korea.title: Seoul to expand military exercise with US after North Korea’s warning
South Korea.summary: South Korea and the US plan to conduct a larger military exercise in response to North Korea’s criticism.

South Korea.title: South Korea’s spy agency says North Korea likely to conduct nuclear test in second half of 2024
South Korea.summary: South Korea’s spy agency says North Korea likely to conduct nuclear test in second half of 2024.

Japan.title: Japan's Government Denies Plan to Revoke Article 9
Japan.summary: Japanese government officials have denied reports that they are considering revising the country's post-war constitution, specifically Article 9, which renounces war as a means to settle international disputes. The denials come after a recent media report sparked concerns that the government could seek to reinterpret or revise the article, which has been in place since 1947.

Japan.title: Tokyo Olympics 2025 Bid Faces Funding Challenges
Japan.summary: Tokyo's bid to host the 2025 Olympics is facing funding challenges, with the Japanese government considering alternative options like reducing the number of events or scaling back infrastructure plans to make the Games more financially sustainable.

Japan.title: Typhoon Haishen Makes Landfall in Japan, Causes Disruptions
Japan.summary: Typhoon Haishen made landfall in Japan, causing disruptions to transportation and daily life. The storm caused widespread power outages, damaged homes, and disrupted communication services in the affected areas.
